verses.original: בֵּאדַ֛יִן דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖א שָׂ֣ם טְעֵ֑ם וּבַקַּ֣רוּ׀ בְּבֵ֣ית סִפְרַיָּ֗א דִּ֧י גִנְזַיָּ֛א מְהַחֲתִ֥ין תַּמָּ֖ה בְּבָבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin dā·rə·yā·weš mal·kā śām ṭə·‘êm ū·ḇaq·qa·rū bə·ḇêṯ sip̄·ray·yā dî ḡin·zay·yā mə·ha·ḥă·ṯîn tam·māh bə·ḇā·ḇel
verses.literal: Thus King Darius ordered . . . a search of the archives stored . . . . . . in the treasury of Babylon . . .
verses.literalPt: O rei Dario expediu um decreto, e um exame foi feito no arquivo, onde em Babilônia foram guardados os tesouros.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁתְּכַ֣ח בְּאַחְמְתָ֗א בְּבִֽירְתָ֛א דִּ֛י בְּמָדַ֥י מְדִינְתָּ֖ה מְגִלָּ֣ה חֲדָ֑ה וְכֵן־ כְּתִ֥יב בְּגַוַּ֖הּ דִּכְרוֹנָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·tə·ḵaḥ bə·’aḥ·mə·ṯā bə·ḇî·rə·ṯā dî bə·mā·ḏay mə·ḏî·nə·tāh mə·ḡil·lāh ḥă·ḏāh wə·ḵên- kə·ṯîḇ bə·ḡaw·wah diḵ·rō·w·nāh
verses.literal: And a scroll was found in the fortress . . . of Ecbatana in the province of Media with the following written on it Memorandum
verses.literalPt: Achou-se em Acmeta, no palácio que está na província de Média, um rolo em que, como memorial, estava escrito como se segue:

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת חֲדָ֜ה לְכ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֗א כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא֮ שָׂ֣ם טְעֵם֒ בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֤א בִֽירוּשְׁלֶם֙ בַּיְתָ֣א יִתְבְּנֵ֔א אֲתַר֙ דִּֽי־ דָבְחִ֣ין דִּבְחִ֔ין וְאֻשּׁ֖וֹהִי מְסֽוֹבְלִ֑ין רוּמֵהּ֙ אַמִּ֣ין שִׁתִּ֔ין פְּתָיֵ֖הּ אַמִּ֥ין שִׁתִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ ḥă·ḏāh lə·ḵō·w·reš mal·kā kō·w·reš mal·kā śām ṭə·‘êm bêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā ḇî·rū·šə·lem bay·ṯā yiṯ·bə·nê ’ă·ṯar dî- ḏā·ḇə·ḥîn diḇ·ḥîn wə·’uš·šō·w·hî mə·sō·wḇ·lîn rū·mêh ’am·mîn šit·tîn pə·ṯā·yêh ’am·mîn šit·tîn
verses.literal: In the first year of King Cyrus he . . . issued a decree concerning the house of God in Jerusalem Let the house be rebuilt as a place for offering sacrifices and let its foundations be firmly laid It is to be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits wide
verses.literalPt: No primeiro ano do rei Ciro, o rei Ciro expediu um decreto concernente à Casa de Deus em Jerusalém: Seja edificada a casa, o lugar em que oferecem sacrifícios e sejam lançados mui firmes os seus fundamentos. Tenha ela sessenta cúbitos de alto e sessenta cúbitos de largo;

verses.original: נִדְבָּכִ֞ין דִּי־ אֶ֤בֶן גְּלָל֙ תְּלָתָ֔א וְנִדְבָּ֖ךְ דִּי־ אָ֣ע חֲדַ֑ת וְנִ֨פְקְתָ֔א מִן־ בֵּ֥ית מַלְכָּ֖א תִּתְיְהִֽב׃
verses.transliteration: niḏ·bā·ḵîn dî- ’e·ḇen gə·lāl tə·lā·ṯā wə·niḏ·bāḵ dî- ’ā‘ ḥă·ḏaṯ wə·nip̄·qə·ṯā min- bêṯ mal·kā tiṯ·yə·hiḇ
verses.literal: with three . . . layers of cut stones . . . and one of timbers The costs are to be paid from the royal treasury
verses.literalPt: com três carreiras de grandes pedras e uma carreira de madeira nova. Que a despesa se faça da casa do rei,

verses.original: וְ֠אַף מָאנֵ֣י בֵית־ אֱלָהָא֮ דִּ֣י דַהֲבָ֣ה וְכַסְפָּא֒ דִּ֣י נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר הַנְפֵּ֛ק מִן־ הֵיכְלָ֥א דִי־ בִירוּשְׁלֶ֖ם וְהֵיבֵ֣ל לְבָבֶ֑ל יַהֲתִיב֗וּן וִ֠יהָךְ לְהֵיכְלָ֤א דִי־ בִירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ לְאַתְרֵ֔הּ וְתַחֵ֖ת בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלָהָֽא׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ap̄ mā·nê ḇêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā dî ḏa·hă·ḇāh wə·ḵas·pā dî nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar han·pêq min- hê·ḵə·lā ḏî- ḇî·rū·šə·lem wə·hê·ḇêl lə·ḇā·ḇel ya·hă·ṯî·ḇūn wî·hāḵ lə·hê·ḵə·lā ḏî- ḇî·rū·šə·lem lə·’aṯ·rêh wə·ṯa·ḥêṯ bə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lā·hā
verses.literal: Furthermore the gold and silver . . . articles of the house of God which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple . . . in Jerusalem and carried to Babylon must also be returned to the temple . . . in Jerusalem . . . and deposited in the house of God
verses.literalPt: e que se restituam os vasos de ouro e de prata da Casa de Deus, que Nabucodonosor tirou do templo que está em Jerusalém e levou para Babilônia, e que se tornem a levar para o templo que está em Jerusalém cada vaso para o seu lugar, e tu os porás na Casa de Deus.

verses.original: כְּעַ֡ן תַּ֠תְּנַי פַּחַ֨ת עֲבַֽר־ נַהֲרָ֜ה שְׁתַ֤ר בּוֹזְנַי֙ וּכְנָוָ֣תְה֔וֹן אֲפַרְסְכָיֵ֔א דִּ֖י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑ה רַחִיקִ֥ין הֲו֖וֹ מִן־ תַּמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kə·‘an tat·tə·nay pa·ḥaṯ ‘ă·ḇar- na·hă·rāh šə·ṯar bō·wz·nay ū·ḵə·nā·wā·ṯə·hō·wn ’ă·p̄ar·sə·ḵā·yê dî ba·‘ă·ḇar na·hă·rāh ra·ḥî·qîn hă·wōw min- tam·māh
verses.literal: Therefore Darius decreed To Tattenai governor of the region west of the Euphrates Shethar-bozenai and your associates and officials . . . in the region . . . You must stay away from that place
verses.literalPt: Agora, vós, Tatenai, governador além do rio, Setar-Bozenai e vossos companheiros, os afarsaquitas, que estais além do rio, retirai-vos longe dali.

verses.original: שְׁבֻ֕קוּ לַעֲבִידַ֖ת בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֣א דֵ֑ךְ פַּחַ֤ת יְהוּדָיֵא֙ וּלְשָׂבֵ֣י יְהוּדָיֵ֔א בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֥א דֵ֖ךְ יִבְנ֥וֹן עַל־ אַתְרֵֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ḇu·qū la·‘ă·ḇî·ḏaṯ bêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā ḏêḵ pa·ḥaṯ yə·hū·ḏā·yê ū·lə·śā·ḇê yə·hū·ḏā·yê bêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā ḏêḵ yiḇ·nō·wn ‘al- ’aṯ·rêh
verses.literal: Leave this work . . . on the house of God alone Let the governor and elders . . . of the Jews rebuild this house of God on its original site
verses.literalPt: Não interrompais a obra dessa Casa de Deus; edifiquem o governador dos judeus e os seus anciãos esta Casa de Deus no seu lugar.

verses.original: וּמִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ לְמָ֣א דִֽי־ תַֽעַבְד֗וּן עִם־ שָׂבֵ֤י יְהוּדָיֵא֙ אִלֵּ֔ךְ לְמִבְנֵ֖א בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֣א דֵ֑ךְ וּמִנִּכְסֵ֣י מַלְכָּ֗א דִּ֚י מִדַּת֙ עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֔ה אָסְפַּ֗רְנָא נִפְקְתָ֛א תֶּהֱוֵ֧א מִֽתְיַהֲבָ֛א לְגֻבְרַיָּ֥א אִלֵּ֖ךְ דִּי־ לָ֥א לְבַטָּלָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min·nî śîm ṭə·‘êm lə·mā ḏî- ṯa·‘aḇ·ḏūn ‘im- śā·ḇê yə·hū·ḏā·yê ’il·lêḵ lə·miḇ·nê bêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā ḏêḵ ū·min·niḵ·sê mal·kā dî mid·daṯ ‘ă·ḇar na·hă·rāh ’ā·sə·par·nā nip̄·qə·ṯā te·hĕ·wê miṯ·ya·hă·ḇā lə·ḡuḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ dî- lā lə·ḇaṭ·ṭā·lā
verses.literal: I hereby decree what . . . you must do for these elders of the Jews who are rebuilding this house of God The cost is to be paid in full to these men from the royal treasury out of the taxes of the provinces west of the Euphrates so that the work will not be hindered
verses.literalPt: Além disso, por mim se decreta o que haveis de fazer a esses anciãos dos judeus para a edificação dessa Casa de Deus, a saber, que, da fazenda do rei, isto é, do tributo dalém do rio, se dê com pontualidade a despesa a esses homens, para que não tenham interrupção.

verses.original: וּמָ֣ה חַשְׁחָ֡ן וּבְנֵ֣י תוֹרִ֣ין וְדִכְרִ֣ין וְאִמְּרִ֣ין׀ לַעֲלָוָ֣ן׀ לֶאֱלָ֪הּ שְׁמַיָּ֟א חִנְטִ֞ין מְלַ֣ח׀ חֲמַ֣ר וּמְשַׁ֗ח כְּמֵאמַ֨ר כָּהֲנַיָּ֤א דִי־ בִירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ לֶהֱוֵ֨א מִתְיְהֵ֥ב לְהֹ֛ם י֥וֹם׀ בְּי֖וֹם דִּי־ לָ֥א שָׁלֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·māh ḥaš·ḥān ū·ḇə·nê ṯō·w·rîn wə·ḏiḵ·rîn wə·’im·mə·rîn la·‘ă·lā·wān le·’ĕ·lāh šə·may·yā ḥin·ṭîn mə·laḥ ḥă·mar ū·mə·šaḥ kə·mê·mar kā·hă·nay·yā ḏî- ḇî·rū·šə·lem le·hĕ·wê miṯ·yə·hêḇ lə·hōm yō·wm bə·yō·wm dî- lā šā·lū
verses.literal: Whatever is needed young bulls rams and lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven as well as wheat salt wine and oil as requested by the priests . . . in Jerusalem must be given to them daily . . . without fail
verses.literalPt: Também se lhes dê, dia após dia, sem falta, aquilo de que tiverem mister: novilhos, carneiros e cordeiros, para holocaustos ao Deus do céu, trigo, sal, vinho e azeite segundo a palavra dos sacerdotes que assistem em Jerusalém,

verses.original: דִּֽי־ לֶהֱוֺ֧ן מְהַקְרְבִ֛ין נִיחוֹחִ֖ין לֶאֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֑א וּמְצַלַּ֕יִן לְחַיֵּ֥י מַלְכָּ֖א וּבְנֽוֹהִי׃
verses.transliteration: dî- le·hĕ·wōn mə·haq·rə·ḇîn nî·ḥō·w·ḥîn le·’ĕ·lāh šə·may·yā ū·mə·ṣal·la·yin lə·ḥay·yê mal·kā ū·ḇə·nō·w·hî
verses.literal: Then they will be able to offer sacrifices of a sweet aroma to the God of heaven and to pray for the lives of the king and his sons
verses.literalPt: para que ofereçam sacrifícios de cheiro suave ao Deus do céu, e orem pela vida do rei e de seus filhos.

verses.original: וּמִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּ֣י כָל־ אֱנָ֗שׁ דִּ֤י יְהַשְׁנֵא֙ פִּתְגָמָ֣א דְנָ֔ה יִתְנְסַ֥ח אָע֙ מִן־ בַּיְתֵ֔הּ וּזְקִ֖יף יִתְמְחֵ֣א עֲלֹ֑הִי וּבַיְתֵ֛הּ נְוָל֥וּ יִתְעֲבֵ֖ד עַל־ דְּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min·nî śîm ṭə·‘êm dî ḵāl ’ĕ·nāš dî yə·haš·nê piṯ·ḡā·mā ḏə·nāh yiṯ·nə·saḥ ’ā‘ min- bay·ṯêh ū·zə·qîp̄ yiṯ·mə·ḥê ‘ă·lō·hî ū·ḇay·ṯêh nə·wā·lū yiṯ·‘ă·ḇêḏ ‘al- də·nāh
verses.literal: I also decree . . . that if any man interferes with this directive a beam is to be torn from his house and raised up and he is to be impaled on it And his own house shall be made a pile of rubble for this offense
verses.literalPt: Também por mim se decreta que todo o homem que alterar este decreto, se arranque uma viga da sua casa, e que ele seja levantado e pregado nela; e que da sua casa se faça um monturo.

verses.original: וֵֽאלָהָ֞א דִּ֣י שַׁכִּ֧ן שְׁמֵ֣הּ תַּמָּ֗ה יְמַגַּ֞ר כָּל־ מֶ֤לֶךְ וְעַם֙ דִּ֣י׀ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְדֵ֗הּ לְהַשְׁנָיָ֛ה לְחַבָּלָ֛ה בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֥א דֵ֖ךְ דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם אֲנָ֤ה דָרְיָ֙וֶשׁ֙ שָׂ֣מֶת טְעֵ֔ם אָסְפַּ֖רְנָא יִתְעֲבִֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wê·lā·hā dî šak·kin šə·mêh tam·māh yə·mag·gar kāl- me·leḵ wə·‘am dî yiš·laḥ yə·ḏêh lə·haš·nā·yāh lə·ḥab·bā·lāh bêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā ḏêḵ dî ḇî·rū·šə·lem ’ă·nāh ḏā·rə·yā·weš śā·meṯ ṭə·‘êm ’ā·sə·par·nā yiṯ·‘ă·ḇiḏ
verses.literal: May God who has caused His Name to dwell there overthrow any king or people who lifts a hand to alter this decree or to destroy this house of God . . . in Jerusalem I Darius have issued the decree Let it be carried out with diligence
verses.literalPt: O Deus que fez habitar ali o seu nome derribe todos os reis e povos que estenderem a mão para alterar o decreto, para destruir essa Casa de Deus que está em Jerusalém. Eu, Dario, expedi o decreto; que se cumpra com toda a pontualidade.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן תַּתְּנַ֞י פַּחַ֧ת עֲבַֽר־ נַהֲרָ֛ה שְׁתַ֥ר בּוֹזְנַ֖י וּכְנָוָתְה֑וֹן לָקֳבֵ֗ל דִּֽי־ שְׁלַ֞ח דָּרְיָ֧וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֛א כְּנֵ֖מָא אָסְפַּ֥רְנָא עֲבַֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin tat·tə·nay pa·ḥaṯ ‘ă·ḇar- na·hă·rāh šə·ṯar bō·wz·nay ū·ḵə·nā·wā·ṯə·hō·wn lā·qo·ḇêl dî- šə·laḥ dā·rə·yā·weš mal·kā kə·nê·mā ’ā·sə·par·nā ‘ă·ḇa·ḏū
verses.literal: In response Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates Shethar-bozenai and their associates . . . diligently carried out what King . . . Darius had decreed
verses.literalPt: Tatenai, governador além do rio, Setar-Bozenai e seus companheiros assim o executaram com toda a pontualidade por causa do que havia ordenado o rei Dario.

verses.original: וְשָׂבֵ֤י יְהוּדָיֵא֙ בָּנַ֣יִן וּמַצְלְחִ֔ין בִּנְבוּאַת֙ חַגַּ֣י נְבִיאָה וּזְכַרְיָ֖ה בַּר־ עִדּ֑וֹא וּבְנ֣וֹ וְשַׁכְלִ֗לוּ מִן־ טַ֙עַם֙ אֱלָ֣הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִטְּעֵם֙ כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ וְדָרְיָ֔וֶשׁ וְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֖שְׂתְּא מֶ֥לֶךְ פָּרָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·ḇê yə·hū·ḏā·yê bā·na·yin ū·maṣ·lə·ḥîn bin·ḇū·’aṯ ḥag·gay nə·ḇī·ʾå̄h ū·zə·ḵar·yāh bar- ‘id·dō·w ū·ḇə·nōw wə·šaḵ·li·lū min- ṭa·‘am ’ĕ·lāh yiś·rā·’êl ū·miṭ·ṭə·‘êm kō·w·reš wə·ḏā·rə·yā·weš wə·’ar·taḥ·šaśt me·leḵ pā·rās
verses.literal: So the Jewish elders built and prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo They finished building according to the command of the God of Israel and the decrees of Cyrus Darius and Artaxerxes kings of Persia
verses.literalPt: Os anciãos dos judeus edificaram e foram bem sucedidos devido à profecia do profeta Ageu e Zacarias, filho de Ido. Edificaram e acabaram de edificar segundo o mandado do Deus de Israel, segundo o decreto de Ciro, de Dario e de Artaxerxes, rei da Pérsia.

verses.original: וְשֵׁיצִיא֙ בַּיְתָ֣ה דְנָ֔ה עַ֛ד י֥וֹם תְּלָתָ֖ה לִירַ֣ח אֲדָ֑ר דִּי־ הִ֣יא שְׁנַת־ שֵׁ֔ת לְמַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּֽא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·šê·ṣî bay·ṯāh ḏə·nāh ‘aḏ yō·wm tə·lā·ṯāh lî·raḥ ’ă·ḏār dî- hî šə·naṯ- šêṯ lə·mal·ḵūṯ dā·rə·yā·weš mal·kā
verses.literal: And this temple was completed on the third day of the month of Adar . . . . . . in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius
verses.literalPt: Acabou-se essa casa no terceiro dia do mês adar, no sexto ano do reinado do rei Dario.

verses.original: וַעֲבַ֣דוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל כָּהֲנַיָּ֨א וְלֵוָיֵ֜א וּשְׁאָ֣ר בְּנֵי־ גָלוּתָ֗א חֲנֻכַּ֛ת בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֥א דְנָ֖ה בְּחֶדְוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·ḇa·ḏū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl kā·hă·nay·yā wə·lê·wā·yê ū·šə·’ār bə·nê- ḡā·lū·ṯā ḥă·nuk·kaṯ bêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā ḏə·nāh bə·ḥeḏ·wāh
verses.literal: Then the people of Israel the priests the Levites and the rest of the exiles . . . celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel, os sacerdotes, os levitas e o restante dos filhos do cativeiro, celebraram com regozijo a dedicação dessa Casa de Deus.

verses.original: וְהַקְרִ֗בוּ לַחֲנֻכַּת֮ בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֣א דְנָה֒ תּוֹרִ֣ין מְאָ֔ה דִּכְרִ֣ין מָאתַ֔יִן אִמְּרִ֖ין אַרְבַּ֣ע מְאָ֑ה וּצְפִירֵ֨י עִזִּ֜ין לְחַטָּיָא עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ תְּרֵֽי־ עֲשַׂ֔ר לְמִנְיָ֖ן שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haq·ri·ḇū la·ḥă·nuk·kaṯ bêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā ḏə·nāh tō·w·rîn mə·’āh diḵ·rîn mā·ṯa·yin ’im·mə·rîn ’ar·ba‘ mə·’āh ū·ṣə·p̄î·rê ‘iz·zîn lə·ḥaṭ·ṭå̄·yå̄ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl tə·rê- ‘ă·śar lə·min·yān šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For the dedication of the house of God they offered a hundred bulls two hundred rams four hundred lambs and a sin offering for all Israel of twelve . . . . . . male goats . . . one for each tribe of Israel
verses.literalPt: Na ocasião da dedicação dessa Casa de Deus, ofereceram cem novilhos, duzentos carneiros e quatrocentos cordeiros; e, como oferta pelo pecado por todo o Israel, doze bodes, segundo o número das tribos de Israel.

verses.original: וַהֲקִ֨ימוּ כָהֲנַיָּ֜א בִּפְלֻגָּתְה֗וֹן וְלֵוָיֵא֙ בְּמַחְלְקָ֣תְה֔וֹן עַל־ עֲבִידַ֥ת אֱלָהָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם כִּכְתָ֖ב סְפַ֥ר מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qî·mū ḵā·hă·nay·yā bip̄·lug·gā·ṯə·hō·wn wə·lê·wā·yê bə·maḥ·lə·qā·ṯə·hō·wn ‘al- ‘ă·ḇî·ḏaṯ ’ĕ·lā·hā dî ḇî·rū·šə·lem kiḵ·ṯāḇ sə·p̄ar mō·šeh
verses.literal: They also appointed the priests by their divisions and the Levites by their groups to the service of God . . . in Jerusalem according to what is written in the Book of Moses
verses.literalPt: Estabeleceram os sacerdotes nas suas divisões, e os levitas, nas suas turmas, para o serviço de Deus, que está em Jerusalém, como está escrito no livro de Moisés.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ בְנֵי־ הַגּוֹלָ֖ה אֶת־ הַפָּ֑סַח בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ḇə·nê- hag·gō·w·lāh ’eṯ- hap·pā·saḥ bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn
verses.literal: On the fourteenth day . . . of the first month the exiles . . . kept the Passover
verses.literalPt: Os filhos do cativeiro celebraram a Páscoa no décimo quarto dia do primeiro mês.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִֽטַּהֲר֞וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֛ם כְּאֶחָ֖ד כֻּלָּ֣ם טְהוֹרִ֑ים וַיִּשְׁחֲט֤וּ הַפֶּ֙סַח֙ לְכָל־ בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה וְלַאֲחֵיהֶ֥ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî hiṭ·ṭa·hă·rū hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim kə·’e·ḥāḏ kul·lām ṭə·hō·w·rîm way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū hap·pe·saḥ lə·ḵāl bə·nê hag·gō·w·lāh wə·la·’ă·ḥê·hem hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·lā·hem
verses.literal: All the priests and Levites . . . had purified themselves and were ceremonially clean And the Levites slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the exiles . . . for their priestly brothers and for themselves
verses.literalPt: Pois os sacerdotes e os levitas se tinham purificado como se fossem um só homem; todos eles estavam limpos. Mataram o cordeiro pascoal para todos os filhos do cativeiro, e para os sacerdotes, seus irmãos, e para si mesmos.

verses.original: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַשָּׁבִים֙ מֵֽהַגּוֹלָ֔ה וְכֹ֗ל הַנִּבְדָּ֛ל מִטֻּמְאַ֥ת גּוֹיֵֽ־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם לִדְרֹ֕שׁ לַֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ḵə·lū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl haš·šā·ḇîm mê·hag·gō·w·lāh wə·ḵōl han·niḇ·dāl miṭ·ṭum·’aṯ gō·w·yê- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·lê·hem liḏ·rōš Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . who had returned from exile ate it together with all who had separated themselves from the uncleanness of the peoples of the land to seek the LORD the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel que tinham voltado do cativeiro e todos os que, unindo-se com eles, se haviam separado da imundícia das nações da terra, para buscarem a Jeová, Deus de Israel, comeram

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֧וּ חַג־ מַצּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה כִּ֣י׀ שִׂמְּחָ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה וְֽהֵסֵ֞ב לֵ֤ב מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם לְחַזֵּ֣ק יְדֵיהֶ֔ם בִּמְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ḥaḡ- maṣ·ṣō·wṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm bə·śim·ḥāh kî śim·mə·ḥām Yah·weh wə·hê·sêḇ lêḇ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr ‘ă·lê·hem lə·ḥaz·zêq yə·ḏê·hem bim·le·ḵeṯ bêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For seven days they kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread with joy because the LORD had made them joyful and turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them to strengthen their hands in the work on the house of the God . . . of Israel
verses.literalPt: e celebraram a Festa dos Pães Asmos por sete dias, com regozijo. Pois Jeová os tinha alegrado, tocando o coração do rei da Assíria a favor deles, a fim de lhes fortalecer as mãos na obra da Casa de Deus, Deus de Israel.
